description: This file is a shell script that sets up, and tests the behavior of 'git merge --signoff' in a git repository. It contains functions to initialize test repositories, create branches, and verify that the signoff message is properly added or omitted based on flags used in the merge commands.

methods.name: test_setup
methods.description: Prepares a test repository with an initial commit, creates a branch, and makes a sample commit.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case to verify git merge --signoff appends the sign-off line.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
